record.question: What is the main therapeutic role of dietary fibres?
options: They help in increasing the blood cholesterol level when it is too low
They help in improving bowel movement and preventing constipation
They are a rich source of vitamin E
They help prevent malnutrition by acting as a food supplement for malnourished children
record.explanation: Answer B: They help in improving bowel movement and preventing constipation. Dietary fiber supports bowel function and can help prevent constipation. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/digestive-diseases/constipation/eating-diet-nutrition. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
